scope: Theorem 7.4 (Detection) of the manuscript “Virasoro Constraints for Projective Complete Intersections” (preprints/Virasoro-Constraints-for-Projective-Complete-Intersections-September-24-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 065 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 01a2df978a0bfae2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume that X has a detection subspace, and that all admissible scalar tests of every positive Virasoro coefficient vanish, with degree weights distinguishing the curve classes under consideration. Then LX k ZX = 0 for every k > 0, for all cohomology insertions and in each such curve class.
